item.title: Watch Operation 7 Save a Life on Saturday, Feb.7 on ABC 7
item.description: Join host Bill Ritter for our 28th annual Emmy Award-winning WABC-TV special Operation 7: Save a Life on Saturday, February 7th at 7:00 p.m.

item.title: NY, NJ and Gateway commission sue over Hudson River Tunnel funding cut, work could stop this week
item.description: New York, New Jersey and the Gateway Development Commission are suing the federal government for cutting off funding for the Hudson River Tunnel, a move that could suspend construction by the end of the week.

item.title: Forgotten piece of music brought back to life and back to Carnegie Hall this Black History Month
item.description: From Carnegie Hall in the 1930s to a powerful performance this week -- this is the story of how one symphony is inspiring musicians and audiences nearly a century later.

item.title: What's new on Broadway? Reality TV star makes stage debut, 'The Lost Boys' coming soon
item.description: Joelle Garguilo discusses some of the shows on and off Broadway, ranging from a reality star's stage debut, a new musical and a show that's changing theater.

item.title: Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show: Doberman pinscher named Penny wins best in show
item.description: A Doberman pinscher named Penny won best in show Tuesday night at the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show, netting U.S. show dogs' most coveted prize.

item.title: Keansburg Fishing Pier collapses into the ocean in New Jersey; no injuries
item.description: Drone video captured the aftermath, showing part of the pier going right into the ocean.

item.title: Father charged after allegedly beating 2-year-old son who is on life support
item.description: The boy is in critical condition with life-threatening injuries and is on life support.

item.title: NYPD releases body cam video of Queens police-involved shooting amid questions over response
item.description: The body camera video released by police on Tuesday, appears to show 22-year-old Jabez Chakraborty with a knife, walking toward officers.

item.title: Residents wake up to flooded homes after water main break creates mess in Sheepshead Bay
item.description: Residents along a street in Brooklyn are dealing with a mess after they woke up Tuesday morning to a water main break that flooded their homes with water and mud.

item.title: 'Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette' premiere held in NYC
item.description: Ryan Murphy's limited series premieres on FX and Hulu on February 12.
